caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden cabinet with a rich, reddish-brown color and a prominent molded top and base. The cabinet has two doors on the front, each featuring a rectangular window composed of five horizontal black slats or shelves, framed by a gold or brass-colored outline. The handles on the doors are small and dark, positioned vertically at the meeting point of the two doors. The cabinet is centered on a plain off-white or cream background, which contains faint rectangular outlines indicating the edges of the drafting paper. There are additional line-drawing details of one of the door's decorative elements on the upper left and lower right corners of the image, showing a close-up of the ornamentation and the shape of the inset panel. The drawing is signed "Gardena Jackson" in the lower right portion near the cabinet.
title: Cabinet
